title: Create a house-standard publishable library
description: Scaffold a publishable library through a stack adapter — `--stack=angular` (ng-packagr/FESM, standalone, Vitest) or `--stack=js` (plain TS, @nx/js with bundler tsc); the default is the workspace's most specific stack — that builds to dist/<directory>, links in-repo via the tsconfig.base.json path alias (the base generator writes it), declares any cross-lib deps as real version ranges (the publish contract only — no workspace:*), and is independently releasable via `nx release` with a git-tag version baseline. The directory defaults to where this workspace keeps libraries, the import path to the workspace's own npm scope.

name.description: The name of the library. Also seeds the default importPath (@<workspace-scope>/<name>) and directory (<libs-dir>/<name>).
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the library?

importPath.description: The npm import path used to consume the library. Must be a valid npm package name. Defaults to `@<workspace-scope>/<name>` (the scope derived from the root package.json name).

directory.description: Workspace-relative directory for the library. Defaults to `<libs-dir>/<name>`, where `<libs-dir>` is detected: nx.json workspaceLayout.libsDir, else where existing libraries live, else `packages`.

prefix.description: The prefix to apply to generated component selectors (stacks with components).

style.description: The file extension or preprocessor to use for component styles (stacks with components). Use `none` for a non-component library.

stack.description: The stack (adapter id) to create the library with: `angular` (an ng-packagr Angular library) or `js` (plain TypeScript via @nx/js, bundler tsc — no ng-package.json). Defaults to the workspace's most specific stack that can create libraries.

nonAngular.description: DEPRECATED — use --stack=js. Kept as an alias so existing invocations keep working.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags applied to the library (used for module-boundary linting).

workspaceDeps.description: Sibling package names to declare as cross-lib dependencies on this library's own package.json, as a real caret range `"<scope>/<dep>": "^<sibling's current version>"` (read from the sibling's package.json, found in the workspace). Short names take the workspace's scope. The published-consumer contract only — in-repo resolution is the tsconfig.base.json path alias; never a `workspace:*`.
